answer_1.quote: We introduced SummaFusion, an abstractive second-stage summarization model.

answer_2.quote: We use ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L and their mean as quantitative metrics to assess summary closeness to the target.

answer_4.quote: We run a human study comparing a baseline summary with the SummaFusion one on 50 random samples from each dataset. Human volunteers are graduate students with professional English proficiency, and we select three volunteers per dataset. Human graders have to decide which summary they prefer or if it is a tie. In the former, they also have to select at least one reason motivating the preference among the three following: the summary is more informative, more fluent or grammatical, or more factually consistent with the source.
answer_4.guideline: Human graders decide which summary they prefer or if it is a tie, and select reasons from: more informative, more fluent or grammatical, or more factually consistent.
